name: Trial of Fears
address: 1050 Queen St Ste 100, Honolulu, HI 96814, USA
photo_attributions: Photo by Trial of Fears via Google Maps
admission_price: General: $38, Express Pass: $46. Large Group Rate: 10% off for 20+ pax
activities: interactive haunted house; hands-on challenges; escape experience; live scare actors; immersive sets; photo opportunities
extra_notes: Age recommendation: 10+ due to intense nature and profanity; parental/guardian waiver required for minors under 18. Young children, toddlers, babies not recommended. Experience duration: approximately 25-35 minutes. Virtual queue system available upon check-in; Express Pass recommended to skip wait. Strobe lights, fog, loud noises, and claustrophobic spaces present—not recommended for those with asthma, epilepsy, heart conditions, or seizure disorders. No photography/videography allowed inside. No outside food, beverages, or alcohol. Guests arriving visibly intoxicated will be denied entry without refund. Wear closed-toe shoes and comfortable clothing (no high heels, flip-flops, or bulky items). All sales final—no refunds, rain checks, or rescheduling. Wheelchair accessibility may be limited; contact ahead for accommodations. Public street parking available nearby (observe regulations; private lot parking may result in vehicle being towed).

Strict rules enforced: no running, touching actors/props, smoking, drinking, eating, or unauthorized photography. Violations result in removal without refund. Street parking available on Malakeke Street.
